products.name: SAMSUNG  65 inch Crystal 4K UHD Smart TV
products.description:
Samsung 65-inch Crystal 4K UHD Smart TV | UA65DU7700

Get ready to be captivated by the Samsung 8 Series Crystal Processor 4K Smart TV.Experience the brilliance of the Samsung 65-inch Crystal 4K UHD Smart TV, designed to elevate your entertainment with its advanced features and stunning visuals.

Display and Design:
The TV features a 1.63-meter screen with a 4K resolution (3,840 x 2,160) and a sleek slim design with a 3 Bezel-less frame. Enjoy a slim look and a modern aesthetic that complements any space.

Video Quality:
The Crystal Processor 4K ensures vibrant and detailed visuals. With HDR and HDR 10+ support, Mega Contrast, and Contrast Enhancer, you'll experience rich colors and deep contrasts. Motion Xcelerator technology smooths out fast-moving scenes, while 4K Upscaling enhances non-4K content to near-4K quality. Filmmaker Mode (FMM) delivers an authentic cinematic experience.

Audio Experience:
Adaptive Sound, Object Tracking Sound (OTS Lite), and Q-Symphony provide an immersive audio experience. The TV delivers clear and dynamic sound through 20W RMS with a 2CH speaker system.

Smart Features:
Running on Tizen™ Smart TV, this model offers a user-friendly interface and supports voice control with Bixby. It works with Alexa and Google Assistant . Enjoy  SmartThings Hub, and IoT-Sensor functionality for a connected smart home experience.

Multi-Device Experience:
Features include Mobile to TV, Sound Mirroring, and Wireless TV On for seamless integration with your other devices. Apple AirPlay and Daily+ are also supported.

Game Features:
Auto Game Mode (ALLM) and HGiG provide an enhanced gaming experience with minimal lag and optimized visuals.

Tuner and Connectivity:
The TV supports DVB-T2 digital broadcasting and includes an analog tuner. Connectivity options include Bluetooth 5.2, three HDMI ports, eARC/ARC, and one USB-A port. It also features RF In for terrestrial or cable input.

Additional Features:
Enjoy Embedded POP, Electronic Program Guide (EPG), and IP Control. The TV offers extensive accessibility features, including Voice Guide in UK English and Hindi, Audio Description, Zoom Menu and Text, High Contrast, SeeColors, Color Inversion, Grayscale, and Picture Off.

Power and Efficiency:
The TV operates on AC220-240V~ 50/60Hz with a maximum power consumption of 165W. It includes an Eco Sensor and is classified as Energy Efficiency Class 3, with Auto Power Saving features.

products.name: Samsung Double Door Refrigerator with Digital Inverter Technology, 253L
products.description:
Are you looking for a refrigerator that combines style, functionality, and energy efficiency? Look no further than the Samsung RT28A32216U Double Door Refrigerator. Available now at your nearest Samsung Plaza, this refrigerator is designed to meet the demands of modern households and elevate your kitchen to new heights.

 

Stylish Maroon Design: The first thing you'll notice about this refrigerator is its striking maroon color and sleek bar door handle. It adds a touch of elegance and sophistication to your kitchen, making it a focal point of your home.

 

Frost-Free Cooling with Multi Flow: Say goodbye to manual defrosting. The frost-free cooling system ensures that ice build-up is a thing of the past, while the multi-flow feature ensures uniform cooling throughout the refrigerator, keeping your food fresher for longer.

 

Generous Storage Space: With three shelves, including an easy-slide shelf, a spacious vegetable box, and four-door pockets, you'll have ample space to organize your groceries, beverages, and fresh produce. The egg tray keeps your eggs safe and easily accessible.

 

Twisted Ice Maker: Enjoy the convenience of an in-built twisted ice maker. Whether you're preparing chilled beverages or need ice for a party, this feature has you covered.

 

Digital Inverter Compressor: The heart of this refrigerator is its digital inverter compressor, which adjusts its speed according to cooling demands. This results in energy savings, reduced noise levels, and longer-lasting performance. 

 

Smart Connect Inverter: Worried about power fluctuations? The Smart Connect Inverter ensures uninterrupted cooling, even during voltage fluctuations. It's a reliable solution that keeps your food fresh and your energy bills in check.

 

Stabilizer-Free Operation: Forget the need for an external stabilizer. This refrigerator is designed to operate efficiently within a wide voltage range of 100V to 300V, protecting it from voltage fluctuations and ensuring its longevity.
